# `touchcue askpass`

- **Usage:** `touchcue askpass [MESSAGE]…`

Answer an OpenSSH askpass prompt

OpenSSH runs the `SSH_ASKPASS` program with no extra arguments, so point it at a link to touchcue named `touchcue-askpass`. `touchcue askpass` passes every argument after it through unparsed.

## Arguments
- **`[MESSAGE]…`** — The prompt OpenSSH passes

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
